title: Why Grandparents Now Outnumber Toddlers Worldwide
hook: The world is running out of kids, and it may be too late.
closing: A much older world is coming, and it will change jobs, healthcare and families for everyone.
question: How many grandparents do you have?

segments.say: For the first time ever, seniors outnumber toddlers worldwide, 705 million of them, and still climbing.
That senior group keeps growing too, heading toward 1.6 billion people by 2050.
By then, seniors will outnumber little kids more than two to one -- a much older world, with far fewer young people.
